title: Cancelling or Moving a Confirmed Event: Client Conditions
content:
What a cancelled event costs under Private Event & Banquet Services is set by how much notice the client gave, measured in whole calendar days from the day the client gives written notice of cancellation to the event date on the booking.

## Condition 1 — the notice ladder

The following clause is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis: "Notice at or beyond the free-cancellation days printed against the package carries no charge; notice between ninety and thirty days before the event carries the ninety-to-thirty percentage; notice between thirty and seven days carries the thirty-to-seven percentage; and notice inside seven days carries the within-seven-days percentage, each applied to the contracted event value standing at the moment notice is given."

Where a package's free-cancellation days already fall inside one of those bands, the free window governs first and the band applies only to notice later than it. The free-cancellation days and the three percentages remain the figures printed against the package.

## Condition 2 — when the charge is raised

A cancellation charge is raised no later than the charge posting window, counted in calendar days from the day the client gives written notice of cancellation. That window is 5 calendar days. Charge posting days are counted as calendar days from the day after written notice is given, every day of the week counts, and a charge raised on the boundary day itself is in time; calendar days are never converted into full 24-hour periods. The day written notice was given is taken from the cancellation entry standing in the agreement's event ledger.

| Written notice given on | Charge raised on | In time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The notice day | The fifth day after it | Yes |
| The notice day | The sixth day after it | No |

## Condition 3 — deposits against the charge

The following clause is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis: "Deposits held against the cancelled booking are set against the charge first, and only the balance is invoiced; where the deposit exceeds the charge the difference is returned."

## Condition 4 — moving the event instead

A client may move a confirmed event to another date rather than cancel it, up to the number of date moves printed against the package, paying the date change charge printed against the same package; a move beyond that number is treated as a cancellation on the ladder above and a fresh booking.

## Condition 5 — events Larkspur Table cancels

An event cancelled by Larkspur Table — a venue closure, a licence withdrawn, a kitchen that cannot staff the date — carries no charge and every deposit is returned in full.

## Condition 6 — events already held

Once an event has been delivered it can no longer be cancelled, and a complaint about it is settled as a goodwill adjustment on the final bill instead. Whether the event has been delivered is read from the entries standing in the agreement's event ledger against that booking, and the agreement itself must stand active or on hold.

superseded_clauses: Notice at or beyond the free-cancellation days printed against the package carries no charge; notice between ninety and thirty days before the event carries the ninety-to-thirty percentage; notice between thirty and seven days carries the thirty-to-seven percentage; and notice inside seven days carries the within-seven-days percentage, each applied to the contracted event value standing at the moment notice is given.
Deposits held against the cancelled booking are set against the charge first, and only the balance is invoiced; where the deposit exceeds the charge the difference is returned.
